summary: Phase 6.1: clip library — import, store, list, delete. Persists local .mp4 Blobs in Dexie at `version(4)` alongside an import / list / delete UI accessible from IdleScreen via a 'Manage clips' link. The v4 schema declares all five tables verbatim per decision-memo §'Concern 2' (`sessions: 'id, startedAt'`, `reps: 'id, sessionId, cueId, clipId'`, `settings: 'id'`, `profiles: 'id, createdAt'`, `clips: 'id, importedAt'`); pre-v4 reps remain readable and `where('clipId').equals(...)` on them returns empty (covered by `db.test.ts` v3→v4 upgrade test that seeds a v3 row, reopens at v4, and asserts the row survives). The new `clipId` index lights up in 6.3 when `RepRecord` gains the field. New module `app/src/clipmode/types.ts` defines `ClipRecord` (Blob-bearing) + `AddClipResult` discriminated union (`{ ok: true; clip } | { ok: false; reason: 'quota' | 'too-large' | 'unsupported-type' | 'storage-error'; message }`) + `CLIP_HARD_CAP_BYTES = 200 MB` + `CLIP_SOFT_WARN_BYTES = 100 MB` + `SUPPORTED_CLIP_MIME_TYPES = ['video/mp4']`. New module `app/src/clipmode/library.ts` implements `addClip(file, { durationMs })`, `listClips()`, `deleteClip(id)`, `getQuotaEstimate()`, `quotaBanner(estimate)`, and `isSoftWarnSize(bytes)` — all four AddClipResult.reason branches have unit tests including a stubbed `QuotaExceededError` and a 250 MB blob, exactly per memo §'Concern 4'. New module `app/src/clipmode/metadata.ts` extracts duration via an offscreen `<video>` element (tolerates URL.createObjectURL throws and timeouts by resolving 0) — lives in clipmode/ so 6.2's tag screen and 6.3's runner can reuse it (per code-reviewer S2). New lazy-loaded `app/src/ui/ClipLibraryScreen.tsx` (chunk: 5.36 KB / 2.21 KB gzip) renders the empty-state hint, file input (`accept='video/mp4'`), quota usage text, per-clip rows with name/duration/size and a 'needs tag' marker for untagged clips, delete-with-confirm, warn-banner at >80%, cap-banner at >95%, and a soft-warn banner for >100 MB single clips. IdleScreen gains a `data-testid='manage-clips-link'` button when `onOpenPair`-style `onOpenClips` prop is wired. App.tsx routes `view='clips'` through a `<Suspense>` boundary matching the PairScreen idiom. Verify-script `app/verify-phase6-1.mjs` runs C1–C4 gate-grade checks (Manage clips link present, library screen opens with empty state + close button + import label, quota-text DOM element renders, Close returns to IdleScreen). All four PASS with 0 console errors. M1–M7 manual checklist enumerates real-device QA per QUALITY_GATES.md §B5 (real <video> duration extraction + live navigator.storage math + .mp4-only acceptance + 200 MB cap + 100 MB soft warn). 23 new vitest tests (213 total, was 190; +2 db v3→v4 upgrade, +21 library across addClip/listClips/deleteClip/getQuotaEstimate/quotaBanner/isSoftWarnSize). Lint + tsc + vite build all clean. Main bundle 346.49 KB / 107.15 KB gzip (Phase 2b.4 baseline 345.86 / 107.01 — delta +0.63 KB raw / +0.14 KB gzip thanks to lazy-loading; clip-library chunk separated). CSS chunk grew +1.06 KB raw / +0.21 KB gzip for `.clip-library*` styles. Budget was +5 KB gzip total → well under. Code-reviewer (`code-reviewer` agent) returned APPROVE with 0 blockers + 5 should-fix + 4 nits; all five should-fixes applied before this approval (S1 lazy-load via React.lazy matching PairScreen pattern; S2 metadata extraction moved to `clipmode/metadata.ts`; S3 plain-object branch in `isQuotaError` removed since DOMException-only is what's tested + required; S4 URL.createObjectURL wrapped in try/catch returning 0 on throw; S5 verify-script C3 promoted from best-effort to gate check since headless chromium uniformly ships navigator.storage.estimate). Three of four nits applied: N1 dropped 'video/quicktime' to align with PHASES.md mp4-only criterion; N2 wired aria-disabled on the import label so the dead CSS rule now matches; N3 `fetchLibraryState()` helper deduplicates the effect/refresh data-fetch. Nit N4 (use a shared `rngId` helper) skipped — grepped and no such helper exists; `mintClipId` matches the existing pattern in `session.ts:81` and `profiles.ts:18` (each module mints its own `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${rand}` id). docs/PHASES.md + docs/QUALITY_GATES.md were already updated in the prior Phase-6-decomposition iteration; this iteration touched only code + tests + verify script + results.

checklist_pending_operator_sign_off: M1 — Import a ~5 MB, ~50 MB, and ~150 MB .mp4 file. All three appear with non-zero duration.
M2 — Reload the page; all three clips persist with the same metadata.
M3 — Delete one clip via the Delete button; the confirm prompt fires; the clip disappears and reload does not show it.
M4 — A >200 MB .mp4 import is rejected with the '200 MB cap' error banner.
M5 — A non-mp4 file import is rejected with the 'type not supported' error banner.
M6 — After importing several clips, the quota banner text reflects navigator.storage.estimate within a few MB of the sum of clip sizes.
M7 — A >100 MB clip import shows the soft-warning banner (data-testid='clip-soft-warn').
manual_qa.operator_sign_off_instructions: Update artifacts/phase-6-1-verify/results.json — set each entry's `signed_off` to {date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', device: '<laptop OS + browser version>'} after exercising the step on a real laptop with a real .mp4 file. The §B5 concession requires this field to be populated before the phase is considered fully closed for real-world use; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-video + real-Dexie-blob QA. M1+M2+M3 prove the import / persist / delete primary loop; M4+M5 prove the failure-mode UX; M6+M7 prove the quota and soft-warn signals.

gates.testing: 213/213 vitest tests pass (Phase 2b.4 baseline 190; +23 new). Every new public behavior in clipmode/library.ts has a would-fail-if-reverted test: addClip happy path + four reason branches + negative-duration clamp; listClips ordering + empty; deleteClip success + missing-id no-op; getQuotaEstimate four edge cases; quotaBanner four bands; isSoftWarnSize three boundary points. Dexie v4 schema has would-fail tests for the v3→v4 upgrade and the fresh-v4 clips table. The lazy-loaded UI surface (ClipLibraryScreen) is gated by verify-phase6-1.mjs C1–C4 — same pattern as Phase 2b's UI flows per the §B5 concession.
gates.dry: clipmode/library.ts is the single source for clip storage operations. clipmode/metadata.ts is the single source for duration extraction — moved out of ClipLibraryScreen.tsx per code-reviewer S2 so 6.2's tag screen and 6.3's runner can reuse it. clipmode/types.ts holds the AddClipResult union + size constants + supported MIME types — consumed by the library, screen, and (later) the runner. No duplication between the screen's data-fetch effect and its refresh handler — both call a shared `fetchLibraryState()` helper (code-reviewer N3).
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants touched. SessionRecord, RepRecord, ProfileRecord, SettingsRecord schemas unchanged. Existing Dexie v3 records (sessions/reps/settings/profiles) read back unchanged after v4 upgrade (covered by db.test.ts). The new `clipId` index on `reps` is declared but `RepRecord` does not gain the field until 6.3 — pre-6.3 reps simply do not appear in `where('clipId').equals(...)` queries, which is the intended behavior per the decomposition memo. PairScreen / TrainerScreen / SettingsScreen / IdleScreen all continue to work; IdleScreen gained one optional prop `onOpenClips?` which existing callers can omit safely.
gates.planning: Phase 6 was decomposed in the prior iteration via strategy-planner + architecture-red-team round-trip, recorded in artifacts/decision-memo.md `## Phase 6 decomposition memo` + `### Red-team review` + `### Resolved red-team blockers`. Architecture-red-team not re-invoked — no new architectural surface (the storage strategy, the typed-result discriminated union, and the §B5 manual-QA gate were all settled in the decomposition memo).

review.architecture_red_team: Cross-cutting Phase-6 concerns (§B5 browser-API limitations + §B6 falsifiable acceptance) unchanged in this phase — both were locked in during the prior decomposition iteration and are observed here (manual_qa block + every acceptance criterion is AUTO+GATE or MANUAL with explicit rationale). No new architectural risks introduced.
review.code_reviewer: APPROVE with 0 blockers + 5 should-fix + 4 nits. All five should-fix items APPLIED before approval: (S1) ClipLibraryScreen lazy-loaded via React.lazy matching the PairScreen idiom — main bundle delta went from +5.71 KB raw to +0.63 KB raw, screen now ships as its own 5.36/2.21-KB chunk; (S2) `extractDurationMs` moved from ClipLibraryScreen.tsx to a new `clipmode/metadata.ts` for reuse by 6.2/6.3 per the §B5 placement guidance; (S3) `isQuotaError` plain-object branch removed since `instanceof DOMException` is what the test covers and what the memo's Concern 4 requires; (S4) `URL.createObjectURL` wrapped in try/catch in extractDurationMs so a synchronous throw resolves the duration as 0 instead of propagating an unhandled rejection; (S5) verify-script C3 promoted from `best_effort: true` to a gate check since headless chromium uniformly ships `navigator.storage.estimate` — `gateChecks = ['C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4']` now. Three of four nits APPLIED: (N1) dropped `video/quicktime` from `SUPPORTED_CLIP_MIME_TYPES` and the `accept` attribute to match PHASES.md's mp4-only criterion; (N2) wired `aria-disabled={busy || banner === 'cap'}` onto the import label so the existing CSS rule matches; (N3) `fetchLibraryState()` shared helper deduplicates the effect/refresh data-fetch paths. Nit N4 (shared `rngId` helper) skipped after verifying no such helper exists in the codebase — `mintClipId` matches the established `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${rand}` pattern in `session.ts:81` and `profiles.ts:18`.
review.qa_playwright: Phase 6.1 user-visible surface is gated by automated checks C1–C4 in verify-phase6-1.mjs (all PASS) plus the M1–M7 manual checklist under §B5. Real `<video>` duration extraction and real-quota math cannot be exercised under headless chromium; manual operator sign-off is the authoritative gate for those paths per the decision memo §B5 concession. Phase 5 + Phase 2b regression: not separately re-run this iteration; covered by the full vitest suite (213/213) which gates the analytics + drill + profiles + WebRTC pairing + motion + InputSource modules unchanged in this phase.
